train_time_calibration: Per-fold projection from real event counts (1.334 graphs/event in the smoke files): 3.24 / 3.27 / 3.29 h; 1.5 x T + 0.5 h = 5.35 / 5.40 / 5.43 h -> --time 05:30:00. The smoke's throughput loop has no per-batch sync; its own 2-epoch fit took 3.05x the rate estimate, but native student_sage 4424084 runs (30 epochs) took 1.13-1.31x the rate prediction, so the excess is a fixed per-epoch cost. At 1.3x a task takes ~4.2 h < 5.5 h. SMASH and DCM graph sizes may differ; the 600 s load allowance is not measured.

known_gaps: Resume path only: smash_train.py sha(mirror/state.json) and the read of effective_config.json from the resume mirror are not wrapped in the EACCES retry; changing them would change the code digest and require a new smoke. An EACCES there goes to the user.
submission_hygiene: Submit with env -u SMASH_RESUME_MIRROR -u SMASH_DCM_PREPARED -u SMASH_NATIVE so login-shell variables cannot leak through --export=ALL.
first_wave_watch: Tasks 0-2 must print 'Training seed ... from epoch 0: ~1.18M train / ~0.40M validation graphs' within ~15 min; an earlier failure -> scancel the array and report (cost <= 0.3 GPU-h). The smoke used from_directory; from_bundle/fetch is covered only by the CPU test.
before_each_evaluate: Manual stop-rule check: e_cls == 0 in two or more seeds sends the census back for checking; a head minimum at epoch 29 flags the run as budget-limited (no extension); written into the evaluation launch entry before submission.
budget: training 30-38 GPU-h (3.3-4.2 h x 9), with three evaluations 31-41 GPU-h against the protocol's 30-37; prepare <= 8 CPU-h
